title: Optimization_review: R pipeline and data for a systematic review of natural and mixed-mode ventilation for indoor air quality, thermal comfort and energy efficiency
description: Reproducibility package for the systematic review From design optimization to adaptive control: a systematic review of natural and mixed-mode ventilation for indoor air quality, thermal comfort and energy efficiency (manuscript in preparation). It contains the R pipeline (LR_S1–LR_S11) implementing a hybrid PRISMA 2020 / SPAR-4-SLR protocol, the inputs and outputs of the Reinert DHC clustering performed in TALL, the taxonomy underlying Table 3 with an automated regression check against the values reported in the manuscript, the manual full-text extraction form (82 documents) and the descriptive results. Full texts of the corpus documents are not included.
